entities.name: Laconia
entities.description: Caliphear the Nightmare's caretaker on Dominaria.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: The powerful, unknown wizard later revealed to be responsible for the barren swamps.

events.summary: Laconia tells Caliphear that her lands are under attack by goblins and Shanodin Dryads.
events.quote: Laconia told his mistress Caliphear that her lands had fallen under attack by goblins and Shanodin Dryads

events.summary: The powerful unknown wizard behind the barren swamps is later revealed to be Coldraith.
events.quote: This was later revealed to be Coldraith

relations.note: He is her caretaker and calls her his mistress.
